summary.text: Scott Cepicky is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 64, part of Maury County, who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a cattle rancher and former professional baseball and football player.

paragraphs.text: Cepicky earned a B.A. in history from the University of Wisconsin-Madison.

According to the legislature's biography, he played professional baseball for the Chicago White Sox and the Minnesota Twins and professional football for the Cincinnati Bengals and the Minnesota Vikings, and he is now a cattle rancher.
Cepicky served on the Maury County Commission from 2010 to 2014, chairing it from 2010 to 2012, and chaired the Maury County Republican Party from 2014 to 2017.
He has been a member of the House since the 111th General Assembly, and the House website lists him on the Education and Insurance committees.
